content: Implement a bounded QMP Unix-stream adapter for W0122 that sends escaped command objects, frames one JSON object at a time, classifies replies/errors/device events, and composes the existing QmpLifecycleAdapter without changing the MetaFlux transport manifest or lifecycle authority.

Content revision 0c57d1f59c5238e6d6c2f06f64607a826a67cc66 implements QmpSocket, its bounded JSON framing/classification, CMake registration, focused socket regression, and W0122 documentation. The content commit was created with Agent Harness (codex) as Author and Committer.

Focused QMP socket regression passed 1/1; the full .#vulkan-runtime configure/build and Vulkan CTest preset passed 91/91. Checkpoint P20260831-084 records the transport boundary and leaves producer wiring, provider freeze, fault injection, and live qualification open.
